item.title: Yoru no Kake Mahjong: Kateba Ano Ko to Hitobanjuu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AleCubicSoft
  • 発売日: 2020-12-19
  • スコア: 5.9/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夜の賭け麻雀 勝てばあの娘と一晩中
  • 英語名: Yoru no Kake Mahjong: Kateba Ano Ko to Hitobanjuu

别名

  • Yoru no Kake Mahjong Kateba Ano Musume to Ichi Banchu

あらすじ

Somewhere in Tokyo, in an exclusive mahjong Club. Rei is a clerk in this club. Her job is to play Mahjong with the guests. Players will operate Rei and play with 3 guests in the authentic Japanese Mahjong. Dead wall draw and Last tile from the wall… It all depends on your skills!!
